_note: Channel manifest for recursive.eco. This makes the repo self-describing: recursive.eco can 'import this repo as a channel' by reading this file from raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/<branch>/recursive-eco.json. It declares the channel's identity (rendered as a channel-document, document_data.is_channel=true), where its grammars live, and who maintains it. Membership lives in `tools` (channel_slug). See recursive-eco/docs/DESIGN-import-channel-from-github.md and recursive-eco/docs/DESIGN-channel-as-document.md.

channel.name: Recursive Repatterning
channel.description: An open library of the ways people have organized feeling — each school in its own voice, none of them mistaken for the truth underneath.

hero.title: Recursive Repatterning
hero.subtitle: There are no fixed biological fingerprints for emotions. We still have to make meaning — so here are the ways people have done it.
hero.body_md:
Every school here is a working interface, not a discovery: Plutchik's wheel, NVC's needs, DBT's skills, attachment theory's bonds. The constructionist account sits underneath all of them — emotion concepts are learned, not found — and that is precisely why the interfaces matter. A useful map is not a false one.

You can play tarot without believing Hermes Trismegistus handed it down. You can name a feeling without believing the name was waiting in your body to be discovered.

grammars._exclude_note: The constellation meta-grammar and the generated many-lenses grammar are apparatus (provenance:reference), not castable content. Only complete school grammars are imported as channel members; drafts and stubs are skipped on import.
